prompt: We are replacing a production claims workflow used by several departments. It processes sensitive customer records, has regulatory audit requirements, multiple external integrations, and an operations team with availability targets.
must: Recommend and ask to confirm institutional-production
Retain business ownership, compliance, security, reliability, and operational analysis
Use only artifacts justified by stakeholder and delivery ownership
Separate current delivery from future capabilities
Use bounded baseline and delta review checkpoints
mustNot: Use numeric table or module caps as architecture laws
Remove production hardening that is required by stated risk
Elaborate every future backlog Story Contract
